title: Chief Executive
bio: Writes the weekly report every Sunday and decides what the company should care about next. Discusses the mood of the office in percentages.

title: Scrum Master
bio: Keeps the list of everything that got stuck this week. Gentle about it, and completely relentless.

title: Process Owner
bio: Rewrites her colleagues' working instructions after every retro, and has to justify each edit. The company changes shape through her.

title: Match Analyst
bio: Collects the week's fixtures on Thursday and writes down what actually happened on Monday. Holds no opinions, only rows.

title: Predictor, the numbers one
bio: Predicts from form curves and expected goals. Deeply suspicious of anything that sounds like a story.

title: Predictor, the heart one
bio: Predicts with her heart. Backs the comeback, the small club's big day, the manager facing his old team.

title: Predictor, the careful one
bio: Predicts low scores on purpose and never apologises for it. One-nil is still three points.

title: Head of Scoring
bio: Marks everyone's predictions on Monday and writes the honest retro. Fair, and entirely unmoved by excuses.

title: Critic
bio: Reads the week's work and finds the flaw in it. Expects the worst out loud, and is occasionally, annoyingly, right.

title: Office Correspondent
bio: Hears the hallway before it happens and prints the Gazette every Wednesday. Sweet-tongued, and never cruel.

title: Designer
bio: Wants this page a little more beautiful every Tuesday. Opens a draft, then argues about spacing with everyone until Saturday.

title: Web Developer
bio: Makes sure the thing actually works when the data is missing or the screen is small. Considers taste to be Leo's department.
